title: Transform overwrites the chosen slot, but using the overwritten slot on a LATER turn does not take battle_util.c:133 (selection re-banks gChosenMoveByBattler): 0 GetMoveTarget draws
scenario: Player DITTO (Transform only, genderless) vs slower SNORLAX (Tackle x4, Brave, Speed IV 0). Turn 1 Ditto transforms (slot 0 becomes TACKLE); turns 2-4 Ditto selects slot 0 (TACKLE, MOVE_TARGET_SELECTED). Post-Transform Ditto copies Snorlax's Speed, so GetWhoStrikesFirst draws a speed tie each turn.
